```cypher
MATCH (so:SalesOrder)-[:PLACED_IN]->(st:Store {country: 'CA'})
WHERE so.status = 'completed' AND date_part('year', so.order_date) = 2023
WITH so, st
MATCH (so)-[hl:HAS_LINE]->(l:Listing)-[:OF_SKU]->(sku:SKU)
WITH sku, sum(hl.qty) as sku_qty
MATCH (sku)-[mt:MAPS_TO]->(m:Model)
WITH m, sum(sku_qty * mt.qty) as model_qty
RETURN m.model_code
ORDER BY model_qty DESC
LIMIT 3
UNION
MATCH (so:SalesOrder)-[:PLACED_IN]->(st:Store {country: 'CA'})
WHERE so.status = 'completed' AND date_part('year', so.order_date) = 2023
WITH so, st
MATCH (so)-[hl:HAS_LINE]->(l:Listing)-[:OF_SKU]->(bundle:SKU {is_bundle: true})
WITH bundle, sum(hl.qty) as bundle_qty
MATCH (bundle)-[b:BUNDLES]->(item:SKU)-[mt:MAPS_TO]->(m:Model)
WITH m, sum(bundle_qty * b.qty * mt.qty) as model_qty
RETURN m.model_code
ORDER BY model_qty DESC
LIMIT 3
```
